topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can see how confusing and upsetting this must be, finding out your car has been towed right from your own driveway. Let's take a deep breath and think this through together. First, it might help to check if there are any signs or notices nearby that could explain why this happened. Sometimes, there might be community regulations or temporary restrictions we might have missed. Next, I can help you look up the local towing services or call the non-emergency number to find out where your car is and what the process is for getting it back. We’ll get through this, one step at a time.
